prefLabel_en: Do you smoke?
definition_en: Self-reported current smoking behaviour, including former smoking, occasional use, daily tobacco use by amount, and exclusive e-cigarette or vape use.
mapping_note: Same topic as LOINC 72166-2; PCNN uses a 6-level list including vapes.

prefLabel_en: Do you have a paid job at this moment?
definition_en: Whether the respondent currently has paid work, including partial sick leave and job loss due to long-term complaints.
mapping_note: Employment-related concept only; response options are PCNN-specific.

prefLabel_en: Household activities (hours per week)
definition_en: Hours per week spent on household activities.
mapping_note: Not the same item. LOINC 57253-7 is OASIS-C functional independence, not hours per week.

prefLabel_en: Family activities (hours per week)
definition_en: Hours per week spent on family activities.
mapping_note: No suitable exact public item found.

prefLabel_en: Indicate your main pain area (front)
definition_en: Main pain region selected on the front body map of the Brief Pain Inventory.
mapping_note: BPI body-map item; regions are instrument-specific.

prefLabel_en: Pain interference with general activity last 24 hours (0-10)
definition_en: How much pain interfered with general activity during the last 24 hours (0 = no interference, 10 = complete interference).
mapping_note: Related pain-interference concept; 24-hour 0-10 scale is from BPI.

prefLabel_en: I don't feel like doing anything
definition_en: CIS20-R item: agreement with 'I don't feel like doing anything' on a 1-7 scale.
mapping_note: Related motivation concept; this is the CIS20-R item.

prefLabel_en: It takes a lot of effort to concentrate on things
definition_en: CIS20-R item: agreement with difficulty concentrating, 1-7 scale.
mapping_note: Related concentration concept; this is the CIS20-R item.

prefLabel_en: Physically I feel I am in bad form
definition_en: CIS20-R item: agreement with 'Physically I feel I am in bad form' on a 1-7 scale.
mapping_note: Related physical-fatigue concept; not an exact CIS item code.

prefLabel_en: Which situation applies to you most regarding paid work?
definition_en: Current main employment or income situation.
mapping_note: Employment-status topic only; PCNN options are study-specific.

prefLabel_en: Net monthly household income
definition_en: Net monthly household income in euro bands, including partner income if the household is shared.
mapping_note: Income topic only; euro cut-points are PCNN-specific.

prefLabel_en: What is your relation to the person for whom you provide information?
definition_en: Relationship of the informant to the study participant when completing on behalf of someone else.
mapping_note: Local informant-relationship item.

prefLabel_en: How are you related?
definition_en: Free-text description of the relationship when completing on behalf of someone else.

prefLabel_en: How did you hear about the post-COVID research?
definition_en: How the respondent learned about the PCNN study.

prefLabel_en: Which research or organization invited you?
definition_en: Recruitment source that invited the respondent.

prefLabel_en: Research code received by email or letter
definition_en: Study linkage code sent to the participant so questionnaire data can be joined to other PCNN data.
mapping_note: Local linkage identifier; not a clinical concept.

prefLabel_en: Enter your GP contact details
definition_en: Free-text general practitioner contact details provided by the respondent.

prefLabel_en: Date discharged from hospital
definition_en: Date the respondent was discharged from hospital; estimation is allowed.
mapping_note: Discharge-date concept; PCNN item allows an estimate.

prefLabel_en: Hospital admission due to corona infection before long-term symptoms
definition_en: Whether the respondent was admitted to hospital for a coronavirus infection before long-term symptoms started.
mapping_note: Column name keeps the original codebook spelling.

prefLabel_en: What applied during hospital admission
definition_en: Whether ICU admission and/or oxygen treatment applied during hospital admission.

prefLabel_en: Estimated number of coronavirus infections since February 2020
definition_en: How often the respondent thinks they were infected with SARS-CoV-2 since the start of the pandemic in the Netherlands.

prefLabel_en: Number of infections confirmed by a positive test
definition_en: How many of the reported infections were confirmed with a positive test.

prefLabel_en: Positive test before long-term coronavirus complaints
definition_en: Whether the respondent tested positive before long-term coronavirus complaints started.

prefLabel_en: Type of coronavirus test for this result
definition_en: Type of test used for the reported positive coronavirus result.

prefLabel_en: Date of this coronavirus test
definition_en: Date of the reported coronavirus test; estimation is allowed.

prefLabel_en: Who told you that you had long COVID / post-COVID syndrome?
definition_en: Source of the long-COVID or post-COVID syndrome attribution.

prefLabel_en: Have you been vaccinated against the coronavirus?
definition_en: Whether the respondent received any SARS-CoV-2 vaccination.

prefLabel_en: Number of coronavirus vaccinations
definition_en: How many coronavirus vaccinations the respondent has received.

prefLabel_en: After how many vaccinations did vaccine-related long-term complaints start?
definition_en: Number of coronavirus vaccinations received before long-term complaints attributed to vaccination started.

prefLabel_en: Date of the vaccination linked to post-COVID vaccination syndrome
definition_en: Date of the vaccination after which post-COVID vaccination syndrome started; estimation allowed.

prefLabel_en: Vaccinations received before coronavirus-related long-term complaints
definition_en: Number of vaccinations received before long-term complaints attributed to the coronavirus started.

prefLabel_en: Long-term complaints after a non-COVID vaccination
definition_en: Whether the respondent ever had long-term complaints after a non-COVID vaccination, for example a travel vaccine or flu shot.

prefLabel_en: Who told you that you had post-COVID vaccination syndrome?
definition_en: Source of the post-COVID vaccination syndrome attribution.

prefLabel_en: Current long-term health complaints due to the coronavirus
definition_en: Whether the respondent currently has long-term health complaints attributed to the coronavirus.

prefLabel_en: Approximate start date of coronavirus-related long-term complaints
definition_en: Estimated start date of long-term complaints attributed to the coronavirus.

prefLabel_en: Approximate recovery date from coronavirus-related long-term complaints
definition_en: Estimated date of recovery from long-term complaints attributed to the coronavirus.

prefLabel_en: Current long-term health complaints due to a coronavirus vaccination
definition_en: Whether the respondent currently has long-term health complaints attributed to a coronavirus vaccination.

prefLabel_en: Approximate recovery date from vaccine-related long-term complaints
definition_en: Estimated date of recovery from long-term complaints attributed to the coronavirus vaccine.

prefLabel_en: Have you ever suffered from depressive symptoms?
definition_en: Lifetime history of depressive symptoms, with optional year of last episode.

prefLabel_en: Which body parts are affected by these colour changes?
definition_en: COMPASS-31 item: body regions affected by skin colour changes.

prefLabel_en: Does your mouth feel abnormally dry?
definition_en: COMPASS-31 item asking whether the mouth feels abnormally dry.
mapping_note: Close to PhenX/LOINC 63981-5 ('frequently dry') but this is the COMPASS-31 wording ('abnormally dry').

prefLabel_en: How many times per month? (diarrhea)
definition_en: COMPASS-31 count of diarrhea episodes per month.

prefLabel_en: How many times per month? (bladder)
definition_en: COMPASS-31 count of bladder-related episodes per month.

prefLabel_en: This most annoying eye complaint is
definition_en: COMPASS-31 item identifying the most annoying eye complaint.

prefLabel_en: COMPASS dependency (eyes)
definition_en: Derived COMPASS-31 eyes-change dependency score calculated by the study pipeline.
mapping_note: Derived variable; not a questionnaire item.

prefLabel_en: May we contact you for additional scientific research?
definition_en: Consent to be approached for additional PCNN scientific research.

prefLabel_en: Consent form for post-COVID research
definition_en: Record that the post-COVID research consent form was presented or completed.

prefLabel_en: Consent form for post-COVID vaccination complaints research
definition_en: Record that the post-vaccination complaints consent form was presented or completed. Column name keeps the original codebook spelling.

prefLabel_en: Confirmation that additional-research permission was not given
definition_en: Check item confirming that the respondent did not give permission to be approached for additional research.

prefLabel_en: Able and willing to travel for additional research
definition_en: Whether the respondent can travel to take part in additional research.

prefLabel_en: May we contact you for a telephone or video appointment?
definition_en: Consent to be contacted by phone or video for additional research.
